Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Body, health & movement

I feel better phrase

also feel better, better (in health), are you better?, I’m better, get better

classical

Traupman 56, 98

Melius mē habeō.

Other words

  • Melius valeō.

    also used · classical · Traupman 56, 98

  • convalēscō, convalēscere, convaluī — get better, recover

    verb, third conjugation; ex morbō, from an illness · also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 13.29.4: ex morbō (Lewis & Short); Dolabella in Cic. Fam. 9.9.1: certum sciō jam convaluisse eam

    Getting better, as against feeling better: jam convaluisse eam, that she is better now (Dolabella, of Terentia).

See also I don’t feel well, better.

SourcesJohn C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): pp. 56, 98.

Lewis & Short: convalesco
